title: Java RCE — ObjectInputStream.readObject on an attacker-supplied request body
note: The cast to SessionState happens AFTER readObject has already constructed the graph, so it is not a control: gadget chains on the classpath execute during deserialization. P0, and the fix is not a try-with-resources tweak (which the code already has) but refusing Java-native deserialization of untrusted bytes, or an ObjectInputFilter allowlist.
